findings.title: baseline_upright_and_lowered
findings.claim: They form one embodied mechanism: stand the practice up, move value outward, and keep that capacity bowed.
findings.mechanism: The focus holds upright establishment and bodily lowering together. Capacity to stand an order up is checked by the willingness to bend, and giving occurs inside that lowered posture; authority and support are therefore disciplined by humility.
findings.reader_payoff: The movement from establishing prayer to giving while in a bowed or humbled posture.
